messages:
Ana (CS): Quick alert 1: new-signups between 08:45-09:05 UTC may show empty sample content after activation. Emails delivered but indexing jobs stalled.

Mike S.: Got it. How many affected?

Ana (CS): 11 tenants so far (mix of trials + self-serve). Need short customer note + private CSM notes. Propose $50 trial credit and offer 30-min enablement.

Luis (Eng): Root cause: worker retry storm after an oversized template pushed by a partner. Plan: restart indexers with lower concurrency, run rate-limited reindex, deploy temp cap on sample size. Ops can call:

POST /internal/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/reindex { "mode": "rate_limited", "parallel": 8 }

deploy-bot: Reindex job queued (job-6012) for 11 tenants.

Nadia (CSM): One high-touch trial flagged; please prioritize and advise when ready so I can schedule enablement.

Mike S.: Kicking reindex now. I'll post status updates every 5-7 minutes.

Mike S.: 3/11 restored (search and sample docs visible).

Luis (Eng): Adding estimated_restore_minutes to job response for CSM visibility. Also patching retry backoff to avoid recurrence.

Mike S.: 11/11 restored. Final smoke checks OK. Error rates back to baseline.

Ana (CS): Communications plan: 1) Send brief GENERAL note to affected self-serve/trial accounts (Julia will publish). 2) CSMs send private notes with offer of credit/extension and schedule enablement. 3) Apply credits per policy. 4) Collect 2-question pulse after enablement: (1) Did onboarding complete? (2) Any blockers? Add responses to tracker.

Nadia (CSM): Will follow up with my trial and book a session.

Ana (CS): Great work. I'll post a short customer completion update in 30m and log an internal RCA for tomorrow's postmortem. :thumbsup:
